deal_value.notes: Approximately $650M for the REMAINING ownership interest not already held (Fiserv was an early investor); prior stake percentage not disclosed, so implied 100% enterprise value is somewhat higher than $650M

calculable.calculation: $650M consideration for remaining stake / $20-25M estimated annual revenue = ~26x-33x; understates the true 100% EV multiple since $650M excludes Fiserv's pre-existing stake
inputs: ~$650M for remaining ownership interest — Finxact/Fiserv press release, https://www.finxact.com/content/finxact/us/en/newsroom/press-releases/fiserv-to-accelerate-digital-banking-transformation-for-clients-with-acquisition-of-finxact.html
$20-25M estimated annual revenue contribution — Baird Equity Research estimate cited by Payments Dive, https://www.paymentsdive.com/news/fiserv-buys-finxact-for-650m/618412/
calculable.caveats: Revenue is a third-party analyst estimate, not a company disclosure; the $650M is for the remaining stake only (prior ownership % undisclosed), so a clean EV/Revenue multiple cannot be firmly established

sources.title: Fiserv to Accelerate Digital Banking Transformation for Clients with Acquisition of Finxact (press release)
Fiserv touts $650M acquisition of Finxact (Payments Dive)
Fiserv to pay $650M to buy the rest of Finxact (Banking Dive)

notes: Announced February 7, 2022; completed later in 2022. No multiple published in the press release or credible trade coverage. Finxact never disclosed standalone revenue/ARR; the only public financial metric is Baird's $20-25M annual revenue estimate, and the $650M covers only the ownership Fiserv did not already hold — both make any implied multiple soft.
